Definition: (as noun) a circle, neighbour, or environs; but chiefly (as adverb, with or without preposition) around
BiblicalUsage: subst; 1) places round about, circuit, round about; adv; 2) in a circuit, a circuit, round about; prep; 3) in the circuit, from every side
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
